title: A tour of The Alhambra with Carlos the Fantastic
text:
Carlos, our guide was exceptional. His knowledge and passion really shone through. The Alhambra is busy at this time of year, but Carlos navigated us beautifully through the crowds.
Carlos the Fantastic!!
author: R9798CAduncanm

title: Best alternative
text: Brilliant tour, really informative and a fab alternative if you can't get tickets for the palace. Carlos F was really good .
author: al-shamiry

title: Enjoying the Alhambra by adding history to each place
text: Andy was the guide and everything was great. He had a lot of knowledge about the place and conveyed it to us in a very pleasant way. Thanks for everything Andy!!!
author: beatrizgH8570VW

title: Incredible
text:
We loved our visit to the Alhambra. Hector is a very pleasant, smiling, and fascinating guide; he knew how to immerse us in the heart of the history of this monument. We were lucky to be only 4 during this tour, which allowed us to discuss many things freely. The place is sublime, you cannot go to Granada without visiting it! 
We recommend it without hesitation!
author: 338lauraneg

title: Amazing place. Highly recommend n
text: It was a hot day but our guide Carlos kept us informed and interested the whole time. Very knowledgeable. It’s such a beautiful place with a fantastic history. Highly recommended.
author: colini258

title: Informative Tour - Alhambra Surroundings
text: By accident, I selected the surroundings of Alhambra instead of the main tour, but it turned out to be a great experience. The tour was informative, and I felt comfortable throughout. Fernando, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable, friendly, and engaging. He explained the history and significance of the area in an interesting way, making the experience enjoyable. Overall, I’m glad I joined the tour and would recommend it to others.
author: Dayanat A

title: Excellent
text:
Our tour guide Hector is very knowledgable about the history of Alhambra. He is friendly and approachable. Hector speaks English and Spanish fluently. Definitely deserved a five star rating.

Thanks Hector,
Patrick
UK/Philippines
author: Patrick M

title: It couldn't be better!
text: Germans, pay attention! Very good German-speaking tour with Carlos. Started on time, extremely friendly. Questions were answered competently. The participants were involved, absolutely great👍
author: Gabriele H

title: A terrific experience
text:
Antonio was a terrific guide.  He was very well informed and spent time explaining what we were seeing.  There were just 4 of us , so he was able to answer any questions each of us posed.  He was with us for about 3 1/2 hours.  
It as. Great introduction to Granada
author: shapiro6901

title: Well done Hector and thank you again.
text:
We spent a few hours that were as enjoyable as they were enriching with Hector. Not only did he provide a lot of information on topics related to the history of the Alhambra, but he also answered many questions that were sometimes far from the central theme. Moreover, he managed to do so with humor and remarkably distinguished himself by linking the French and Italian languages.
In conclusion, he highlighted the harmonious intertwining of cultures to inspire the current world towards more intelligence and humanity.  Well done and thank you again Hector.
author: fraizyj
